Vendored browser libraries
==========================

marked 11.1.1 — MIT — https://github.com/markedjs/marked
DOMPurify 3.0.6 — Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0 — https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify

These are the exact minified builds previously loaded from jsDelivr. Keeping
them local removes a third-party DNS/TLS dependency from the first paint.
